rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for two-way communication or exchanging ideas, including communication by sign language.

example.english: We need to communicate using sign language.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jung6 sau2 jyu5 gau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this more formal word for transmitting a message, idea, or information rather than for ordinary conversational exchange.

example.english: This report will communicate the company’s position.
example.traditional: 呢份報告會傳達公司嘅立場。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 wui5 cyun4 daat6 gung1 si1 ge3 lap6 coeng4

rows.note: Use this casual construction when you mean telling a particular person some information directly.

example.english: I communicate to Ming that I will not go to work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我話畀阿明知我聽日唔返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 aa3 ming4 zi1 ngo5 ting1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1
